notes.title: Game Update: Volume Control Added!
notes.content:
Hello, Players!

We’re excited to announce a new feature in the latest update: Volume Control! You can now adjust the game’s audio levels easily with a Volume Bar, available in both the Main Menu and the In-Game Menu.

Here’s what’s new:

• A Volume Bar has been added under Options in the Main Menu for adjusting the audio settings before you dive into the game.
• The same Volume Bar is also available in the In-Game Menu, allowing you to fine-tune your audio experience without having to leave your session.

This small but important update is part of our ongoing efforts to improve your gaming experience. We’re committed to making the game more enjoyable, and we look forward to hearing your feedback!

Thank you for your continued support!

Thanks for playing Come with Me!

notes.title: Day One Patch
notes.content:
[b]FIXED BUGS in Online Co-op[/b]
[list]
[*] Player position not updated correctly under high network latency
[*] World buttons desync
[*] Host selecting character is not synced before guest joining game session
[*] New players who play as the host sometimes cannot load level
[*] Return from in-game disconnect menu does not disconnect game session, which prevents games to run local mode
[*] Added more option when selecting regions
[/list]

[b]FIXED BUGS in UI[/b]
[list]
[*] In memory scene, players can press enter multiple time to enlarge the memory image multiple times
[*] In memory scene, players can transverse to other memories and enlarge them when already enlarging a memory
[/list]

[u]Options coming soon![/u]

Thanks for playing Come with Me!
